svg.title: Pastry Pirates — V1 · The Plank — All pieces on one sheet
svg.desc: Every piece except the board, nested in a 300 mm wide sheet. Re-run with --sheet to change the width. Units: mm. 20 mm squares, 3 mm material. RASTER = black fill (engrave), CUT = red hairline (cut). Generated by physical-board/generate.mjs.
